cases.basis: Four directions retain the same flat silhouette, margins and equal optical weight. Extra shading was not needed.
cases.tradeoffs: No extra detail; the intentionally flat style is retained.

cases.basis: Lock arch and filter rim now match the two-pixel stems better. Refresh was revised after the first sheet to restore a curved clockwise form. Add/remove/transfer remain stable.
cases.tradeoffs: The refresh ring is heavier than the thin baseline; a deliberately fine-line project should retain the old style.

cases.basis: Cockpit, pointed nose, swept wing and connected engine direction establish the upper-right flight axis. Exhaust is separated from the hull and the unrelated spark is removed. A targeted revision moved exhaust two pixels down/left to leave an explicit silhouette gap.
cases.tradeoffs: More cockpit and hull detail; the simpler baseline remains preferable for a minimal pictogram brief.

cases.basis: Same octagonal silhouette now uses crystal facets, a hard metal reflection band and matte stone planes/cracks. Material differences remain visible in grayscale.
cases.tradeoffs: More colors and operations than the simple palette-swap baseline; no palette-count or authoring-speed gain claimed.

cases.basis: Focus has a persistent outer cue, selection has a check and underline, and pressed offsets the play glyph with an inverted bevel. Meaning survives grayscale better than color-only changes.
cases.tradeoffs: Focus/selection decoration consumes inner padding; these are 32x18 symbol buttons, not proof that long text labels fit.

cases.basis: Navigation selection, two content groups and the primary action have distinct positions and visual emphasis. Header emphasis stays below the action; reserved text rectangles are clear.
cases.tradeoffs: Actual font and translated content were not tested. The panel is a layout study, not a finished application screenshot.

cases.basis: Power mark is familiar; on has an inset plus a bottom marker. Opposed arrows occupy separate lanes in both mode instead of overlapping, preserving input/output direction at native scale.
cases.tradeoffs: Both mode has smaller arrow shafts than single-direction modes. This tradeoff was inspected at 1:1; game hitboxes/UV remain untested.

cases.basis: Three recessed slots and two raised actions already have coherent bevels and spacing; current dimensions and artwork are retained.
cases.tradeoffs: Existing unused panel space remains available for runtime content; no redesign or text-fit claim.
